tests.result: Focused Kite lineage, runner, archive, and live-loop tests passed; see PR CI for full suite.

verified: Kite event preserves source event, receipt, availability, and ingest clocks; raw source digest is part of normalized event identity.
Optional RawQuoteArchive stores canonical JSON of parsed Kite SDK quote objects with a payload digest and durable hash chain; it is not raw HTTP wire bytes.
Normalized quote references archive sequence and chain digest; simulated fill receipt hashes the normalized event, establishing fill → event → archived quote lineage.
Existing read-only intraday polling loop can opt into the archive; no archive is enabled by default.
Synthetic tests verify explicit attestation gate, event/archive/fill linkage, tamper detection, and runner integration.
blockers: No independently verified data-provider retention-rights record is available; the archive checks only caller-supplied attestation fields.
No authorized live-market capture has been observed; real session evidence still requires owner login and an eligible market session.
